description: Opus BB unit B20: King's Rock's appended flinch is one of `move.secondaries`, so the target's `ModifySecondaries` removes it: Gengar's King's Rock Seismic Toss never flinches Shield Dust Chansey. Mold Breaker Alakazam's King's Rock Seismic Toss ignores the breakable Shield Dust of Snorlax and flinches it 10% of the time. Both targets are slower (Harden shows the flinch).
